summary: Iteration 11 · P0 provenance-leak retest. All targeted contracts now hold. E2E audit (Anthropic direct route, real 1024-in / ~4000-out Claude call) completes and stream_logs contains the canonical `anthropic-direct · model=claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 · in=1024 · out=<N>` line, tagged OK, positioned AFTER the STEP-3 findings emissions and BEFORE the STEP-4 risk-map block, and the same line is present verbatim in the GET /api/audits/{id}/audit-log export. Two small code fixes applied by testing agent: (1) added ` · ` separator before `out=` in server.py prov_line formatter to match reviewer's canonical string spec, (2) moved provenance _emit_log call to sit right after the 'Logic engine returned N findings' sentinel (previously it fired before the findings loop), (3) added _provenance stamp to the pre-LLM offline short-circuit in llm_service.analyze_documents so the reviewer-specified unit test asserts `_provenance['route']=='offline-fallback'` holds. Full regression: iteration_10 (18) + iteration_9 (11 incl. 1 skipped) + iteration_8 (17) + zero_gap_closure (11) + billing/regulator/stripe (54) = 110 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed.

minor.issue: Class-scoped fixture defined as instance method — PytestRemovedIn10Warning. Convert to @classmethod. Non-blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Optional polish: (a) migrate class-scoped `hb` fixture to @classmethod to silence PytestRemovedIn10Warning; (b) add a 30-60s TTL cache around /api/system/heartbeat since it bills the user's Anthropic key on every hit — trivially DoS-able on a public endpoint; (c) consider adding an EMERGENT_LLM_KEY branch integration test that hits the real emergentintegrations path (currently only mocked).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 962 lines — over the 700-line threshold in the internal code-review checklist. Suggest splitting routing modules (audits, payments, regulator, public, auth) into thin routers.

_stream_publish() fires-and-forgets the mongo persist via asyncio.create_task without awaiting or gathering; on high-frequency emit bursts (e.g., 14 findings + 5 roadmap items back-to-back), event-loop ordering can theoretically deliver mongo pushes out of insertion order. Not observed in this run but worth a documented ordering guarantee if the .log export is legally binding.

llm_service.analyze_documents previously silently discarded provenance on the no-keys short-circuit; fixed. Consider unit-testing every branch of _provenance shape as a schema (route, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, optional error).
The public /api/system/heartbeat endpoint issues a real billed Anthropic call on every unauthenticated hit — flagged in iteration_10 but still outstanding.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_11 closes the P0 provenance-leak flagged in iteration_10. The .env now has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unquoted (confirmed). Canonical stream_logs line is: `anthropic-direct · model=claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 · in=<N> · out=<N>` (tag=OK). If future iterations touch _run_processing, the required ordering is: Materiality assessment → findings loop → 'Logic engine returned N findings' → PROVENANCE line → STEP-4 'Quantifying value-at-stake' block.
rca of the issue: iteration_10 fix by main agent was 90% correct but missed two contract points: (a) the ` · out=` separator was ` ` (space) not ` · ` — cosmetic but breaks reviewer's exact string match; (b) the emit was placed BEFORE the findings loop instead of AFTER — reviewer explicitly required it anchored to the logic-engine COMPLETION sentinel (`Logic engine returned N findings`) so that in the .log export the operator sees findings-then-provenance-then-riskmap. Both fixed. Also, the no-keys short-circuit in llm_service.analyze_documents returned a raw fallback dict without a _provenance key; server.py would then emit `unknown · model=None` — technically not offline-fallback. Fixed by stamping _provenance on the short-circuit path.
